viv: Quick experiment idea — "Hackday Launch" to drive quick API adoption. Offer: 800 tokens on signup + 200 attendee bonus. Short live demo (12m) + 2 follow-ups. KPI: +15% first-api-call within 72h. :rocket:

raj: nice. timeline? can we turn landing + modal in 3 days?

cleo: yes. UX: auto-credit 800 at signup, attendee sees "Claim 200" modal that includes a runnable snippet + a "Run with credits" CTA.

dan: copy idea: test subject lines A) "Run a prompt today — 1,000 free tokens" B) "Hack with Redwood — starter prompts + tokens". split 50/50.

growth-bot: suggested channels: Twitter devs, small GH placements, targeted newsletter. est budget $1.5k.

analytics-bot: new events to track: `hackday_registrant`, `hackday_attendee`, `hackday_credit_claim`, `first_api_call`. include utm props.

viv: landing query string: `?utm_source={{channel}}&utm_campaign=hackday_0824&cohort={{cohort}}`. dan please add cohort and variant.

dan: will add. PR by Tue AM. preview link when ready.

cleo: onboarding nudge: if user claims but doesn't call API in 48h, send an in-app toast + email with one-click "Run sample prompt". reduces drop-off.

raj: compliance: callout that credits are for hosted API only. add short line on landing and modal.

viv: action owners: cleo = UX + prompt pack, dan = landing + tracking, raj = growth buys, analytics-bot = dashboard, ops-bot = preview + recording. Quick sync Thu for go/no-go. :eyes:
